My thing is almost ready, just need a couple more items.}} ==Guide== {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' |- |[[File:GZHELKArmorIcon.png|link=BNTI Gzhel-K body armor]] |[[BNTI Gzhel-K body armor]] |2 |Handover item !No |} In this quest you have to hand over 2 [[BNTI Gzhel-K body armor]]s. One with 0-50% durability and one with 50-100% durability. The armors require no inserted armor plates since the condition is measured by the integrated soft armor. Since friendly fire is always active, you can easily complete this quest with the help of a another player through the use of a [[20x1mm toy gun|Blicky pistol]]. Another way to complete this quest solo is to let [[border snipers]] shoot you so that your character dies far outside the playable space of the map. You can insure the armor with [[Prapor]] to receive it back in roughly a day to a day and a half, but it will be quicker if you use [[Therapist]] to insure it. You may have to do this method multiple times for the same armor to get it down to the required durability. Another option is to shoot the orange propane containers found on [[The Lab]] or [[Customs]] whilst being inside the radius. The hot gas damage will damage all parts of your armour, this will however also deal a lot of body damage and may kill you if you are not being careful. It is best not to stand directly next to the propane while it explodes, and to only use one explosion at a time.
